description: Use this when the user asks whether a website's structured data (schema.org JSON-LD) describes the business correctly. It reads the homepage's JSON-LD and reports the business type it found (Organization, LocalBusiness or a subtype), which business fields are present, missing or look off (name, url, phone, address, hours and more), and where the structured data and the page disagree. Input: one public website. Reads robots.txt, the homepage, /llms.txt and /.well-known/search as PreferlyBot; changes nothing.

website.description: The public website to check, like example.com or https://www.example.com. One site per call.

name: check_business_schema
title: Check business structured data
